HypoPG 1.4.5, commit `9ab5c4fd3701b14ca3c996da360bba9fa5e9b970`.

https://github.com/HypoPG/hypopg/tree/9ab5c4fd3701b14ca3c996da360bba9fa5e9b970

Steward supplies the module magic, calls the planner hook initializer on demand, namespaces the GUC names and exposes a restricted subset of the SQL entry points. The linker exports only Steward entry points. The upstream `LICENSE` applies to this directory.
